question: dame una muestra del diez por ciento de los clientes
sql: SELECT customer_sk FROM (SELECT customer_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_sk) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count FROM dim_customer) WHERE row_num <= total_count * 0.1
